summary: Dream: an omen in the Odes, a doubt in the Zhuangzi, and in the Diamond Sutra a figure for everything conditioned.
placement: Chosen by farthest-point sampling on the integrated Lorenz-84 trajectory, so the eight stars spread across its projected shape. 望 takes the highest point, gazing up; 劫 the point farthest from the rest, at the edge of the eon. A design choice, not a claim.

satellites.title: What Are the Lucky Dreams?
satellites.evidence: The Odes, Sigan: 吉夢維何？維熊維羆，維虺維蛇 … 維熊維羆，男子之祥；維虺維蛇，女子之祥 — the lucky dreams are bears and snakes, and the diviner reads bears as the omen of sons and snakes of daughters. Here a dream is a message from what is coming.

satellites.title: No Longer Dreaming of the Duke of Zhou
satellites.evidence: Analects 7.5: 甚矣吾衰也！久矣吾不復夢見周公 — “how far I have declined! It is long since I dreamed of the Duke of Zhou.” Confucius measures his failing hope by a dream that no longer comes.
